preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The price of each vertex is a non-negative integer up to 10^9.
Each edge in the tree connects two vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: s is the minimum possible cost Arkady has to pay to guarantee his own win
postconditions.description: Arkady needs to find the minimum total cost he has to pay on the first stage.

postconditions.expression: k is the number of vertices that belong to at least one optimal set
postconditions.description: Arkady needs to identify the vertices that are part of the optimal sets.

postconditions.expression: The output contains k distinct integers in increasing order
postconditions.description: The indices of the vertices that belong to at least one optimal set should be printed in increasing order.
